main_apparatus.note: The original Zhouyi judgments and line statements are the main text (transformable); the commentaries (邵雍河洛理數解卦, 傅佩榮解卦手冊, etc.) constitute apparatus and are not transformable. The current staging mixes them; a future apparatus-splitter pass will separate them.
